title.narrative: KISTI-UNESCO Collaboration for Advancing Open Science & Software Heritage

description.narrative: The project is expected to achieve several concrete outputs, including: 1. Development of Mechanisms for Data Openness: The project will create a mechanism to identify key challenges related to the openness of data that require strategic intervention. This will involve careful planning and the establishment of robust enforcement and monitoring mechanisms to ensure policies are not only theoretical but actively practiced. 2. Tailored Data Policies: Utilizing UNESCO's Open Data guidelines , the project will develop and tailor data policies for a few countries and their research institutions, addressing the pressing need for dedicated data policies in many regions. 3. Harmonization with the Open Science Policies by introducing Diamond Open Access: The project will emphasize the integration of diamond Open Access within KISTI’s ongoing effort on Open Access by recognizing the shared challenges and barriers related to openness on scientific knowledge. This will help in the development of a common understanding among stakeholders about the Diamond Pathway of Journal Production. 4. Promotion of Equitable Access of Scientific Research: The project will implement strategies to democratize scientific knowledge, ensuring that research findings, particularly those from publicly funded research, are accessible to a broader segment of society. 5. Development of a Global Software Heritage Repository, which will incorporate KISTI’s experiences of Software Management System
